name: com.allstacks/allstacks-mcp
title: Allstacks Analytics MCP Server
description: Provides 170 tools and 2 resources for AI-native engineering intelligence via Allstacks API. Supports Bearer token (PAT) or HTTP Basic authentication.

ALLSTACKS_TOKEN.description: Personal Access Token for Bearer auth (recommended; required for SSO-only users). Generate from Allstacks UI under Personal Access Tokens. For HTTP Basic auth alternative, see README.

ALLSTACKS_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for Allstacks API (default: https://app.allstacks.com/api/v1/)

ALLSTACKS_PROMPT_GUARD.description: Set to '1' to enable PromptGuard response scanning for indirect prompt injection (default: disabled). See PROMPTGUARD.md.

ALLSTACKS_PROMPT_GUARD_FAIL_OPEN.description: Set to '1' to allow responses through when the external scanner is unreachable (default: fail-closed).

ALLSTACKS_PROMPT_GUARD_URL.description: URL of an external PromptGuard scanner service (e.g. Llama PromptGuard 2 wrapper). Optional; built-in heuristics run regardless.

ALLSTACKS_PROMPT_GUARD_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for authenticating with the external PromptGuard scanner service.
